content.title: What is your zodiac sign? What it says about you and your character
content.text: "What's your sign?"You've probably been asked this at some point in your life. Some people love this question, while others may roll their eyes at it. But many believe their zodiac, or star sign, gives real insight into their personalities, romantic interests, friendships and even professional goals. Whether you're a faithful horoscope reader or not, knowing your sign, at the very least, can be a fun way to connect with others and consider how you relate to the world.Your "sun sign," is based on your date of birth and is associated with traits that can help shape your approach to life.Here's an overview of the zodiac's 12 signs.Zodiac sign datesAries: March 21 to April 19Taurus: April 20 – May 20Cancer: June 22 – July 22Leo: July 23 – Aug. 22Virgo: Aug. 23 – Sept. 22Libra: Sept. 23 – Oct. 23Pisces: Feb. 19 – March 20Zodiac sign compatibility 101: Which astrology sign am I most compatible with?What does my zodiac sign say about me?Aries: March 21 – April 19Aries is a fire sign, and it is the first in the zodiac. Known to be competitive, those born under Aries are courageous, strong-willed and carefree. Appropriately, the sign is symbolized by the ram.Taurus: April 20 – May 20Taurus is an earth sign and is commonly associated with stubbornness. Fittingly, its symbol is the bull. Tauruses are also generous and dedicated, unafraid to take their time and resilient.Gemini: May 21 – June 21Gemini is an air sign and is symbolized by a set of twins. Bearers of this sign are communicative, intellectual and curious, often filling their plates so that busyness abounds.Cancer: June 22 – July 22Cancer is a water sign, rounding out the four elements. It is represented by the crab. Despite their hard exteriors, Cancers are deeply emotional creatures. They often experience high levels of sentimentality and compassion.Leo: July 23 – Aug. 22Leo is a fire sign and is symbolized by the lion. They are natural-born leaders and are driven by a courageous spirit. Leos are also considered to be hard-working, confident and loyal.Virgo: Aug. 23 – Sept. 22Virgo is an earth sign, symbolized by a maiden (who is occasionally seen holding wheat). Virgos are said to be analytical, detail-oriented and highly practical. This occasionally leads to perfectionism. They love to help but are fierce self-critics.Libra: Sept. 23 – Oct. 23Libra is an air sign. Represented by scales, it's no surprise that this sign loves harmony. Libras are said to be creative and idealistic. Those born under the sign can also be indecisive and often weigh their options, struggling to commit.Scorpio: Oct. 24 – Nov. 21Shocker: Scorpio is represented by a scorpion. The water sign is known to be determined, passionate and competitive. Those born under Scorpio are also considered mysterious and intense.Sagittarius: Nov. 22 – Dec. 21Sagittarius is a fire sign, symbolized the archer. The sign is quite adventurous and free-spirited, constantly seeking travel and change. However, this carefree nature can lead to inconsistency.Capricorn: Dec. 22 – Jan. 19The final earth sign, Capricorn is represented by the sea goat. Those born under the sign are seen as ambitious, practical and focused. They can be a shoulder to lean on but also can become pessimistic or cold.Aquarius: Jan. 20 – Feb. 18Aquarius is an air sign, not a water sign, despite its symbol: the water bearer. They are forward thinkers and tend to be clever, creative and intelligent. They can also be distant and struggle to express emotion.Pisces: Feb. 19 – March 20Pisces is symbolized by two fish and is the last of the water signs. Those born under the sign are considered empathetic and intuitive. They can easily read the emotions of others and are ruled by their own. Pisces are understanding and romantic, experiencing the world through heightened sensitivity.What does my sign say about love?Certain signs are more compatible with others. It's not as simple as: "Does my sign go with this other one?"Who you are attracted to and what you need in a romantic relationship also depends on your full zodiac chart — your sun, moon and rising sign. These are the full constellation of your astrological being signal what might be the best pairing for a life partner.There are a few guidelines when considering who is written in the stars for you to love. For example, Aries goes well with Leos because of their direct energy. But it's not a safe a bet — two fire signs can combust rather than balance one another.If you want to know your astrological match, check out our guide.Guide to fire, water, earth, air signs: Understanding the Zodiac elements.Learn more about each zodiac signAries | Taurus | Gemini | Cancer | Leo | Virgo | Libra | Scorpio | Sagittarius | Capricorn | Aquarius | PiscesAstrology's 'Big Three': What your sun, moon and rising sign say about youContributing: Anna KaufmanThis article originally appeared on USA TODAY: See zodiac signs by month, date, traits.
